definitions.gloss: thoroughly, completely, to the bitter end
definitions.explanation: Doing something all the way through without stopping or compromising; pursuing to the extreme.

examples.japanese: とことん{話|はな}し{合|あ}おう。
とことん{追|お}い{詰|つ}められた。
examples.english: I was driven into a corner completely.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}にはとことんこだわる。
examples.english: We are thoroughly committed to quality.

examples.japanese: とことんやってみよう。
examples.english: Let's go all the way with this.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Possibly derived from the sound of footsteps going on endlessly ({とことこ}), with intensification.

NUANCE: Implies determination and persistence. Can be:
- Positive: thorough effort, dedication
- Negative: being pushed to extremes, cornered

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とことん{話|はな}し{合|あ}う (discuss thoroughly)
- とことん{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (corner completely)
- とことんこだわる (be particular about to the extreme)
- とことんやる (do thoroughly)
- とことん{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (see it through together)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {徹底的|てっていてき}に (thoroughly) - more formal
- {最後|さいご}まで (until the end) - neutral
- とことんまで (to the very limit) - intensified form

REGISTER: Slightly casual, conversational. More colloquial than {徹底的|てっていてき}に.
